lines.zh: 冷水里我游得很慢，但不停。
lines.en: In cold water I swim slowly but never stop.

lines.zh: 冰封海沟上方透下一点光。
lines.en: A little light leaks through the frozen trench above.

lines.zh: 尾鳍懒懒一摆，我滑过石台。
lines.en: A lazy tail beat slides me over a stone shelf.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰下的暗流走。
lines.en: I ride the dark current beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 身体重，水又冷，我一步一挪。
lines.en: Heavy body, cold water; I inch along.

lines.zh: 冷得发麻，我反而更清醒。
lines.en: The cold numbs me, and I wake up.

lines.zh: 我绕过冰柱，动作像在打盹。
lines.en: I round an ice pillar, moving as if asleep.

lines.zh: 这条沟很深，我慢慢往下蹭。
lines.en: This trench runs deep; I ease my way down.

lines.zh: 我的鳍几乎不动，靠水流送。
lines.en: My fins barely move; the current carries me.

lines.zh: 冰层裂了一声，我抬头看。
lines.en: The ice cracks once; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 在寒冷海沟里，快游是浪费。
lines.en: In a cold trench, speed is a waste.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴，划过一片黑水。
lines.en: I drag my tail through a stretch of black water.

lines.zh: 越往下越冷，我越舒服。
lines.en: The deeper and colder it gets, the better I feel.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟壁，像一块会动的石头。
lines.en: I hug the wall like a moving stone.

lines.zh: 我从冰洞口滑进去，很窄。
lines.en: I slide into an ice mouth; it is narrow.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，我能停很久。
lines.en: My gills open and close; I can hover long.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，才决定往哪。
lines.en: I circle once before I choose a way.

lines.zh: 沟底的石头很滑，我蹭过去。
lines.en: The trench floor is slick; I graze past it.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，半天不动一下。
lines.en: I hold still and do not move for ages.

lines.zh: 饿得慢，我一年吃不了几顿。
lines.en: My hunger is slow; I eat few meals a year.

lines.zh: 一条鱿鱼游过，我懒得追。
lines.en: A squid swims past; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 冷水让我省着力气。
lines.en: Cold water lets me save my strength.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，其实全看着。
lines.en: My eyes are half shut, but I see everything.

lines.zh: 冰层上面有脚步声，很远。
lines.en: Footsteps above the ice, very far away.

lines.zh: 安静久了，我听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: In the long quiet I hear my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 小鲨鱼在附近转，我不理。
lines.en: A small shark circles nearby; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，海水灌进来。
lines.en: I yawn and seawater floods my mouth.

lines.zh: 睡一会儿，猎物不会跑。
lines.en: A short sleep; the prey will not escape.

lines.zh: 寒冷海沟里，时间过得很慢。
lines.en: Time moves slowly in the cold trench.

lines.zh: 我的身体像冻住了一样沉。
lines.en: My body feels as heavy as frozen stone.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我先不动。
lines.en: Something sinks down; I stay still.

lines.zh: 等得够久，连冰都变温了。
lines.en: Wait long enough and even the ice feels warm.

lines.zh: 你从冰洞口下来，我看见了。
lines.en: You came down through the ice hole; I saw.

lines.zh: 我抬头，动作慢得让你着急。
lines.en: I raise my head as slowly as you can bear.

lines.zh: 你穿得这么厚，水里不热吗？
lines.en: Dressed that thick; is the water warm to you?

lines.zh: 我盯你很久了，只是没动。
lines.en: I have watched you a while; I simply did not move.

lines.zh: 你的灯太亮，照得我眼疼。
lines.en: Your lamp is bright; it stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 冷海里的活物不多，你算一个。
lines.en: Few living things come here; you count as one.

lines.zh: 我不急，你也不会马上走。
lines.en: I am in no hurry, and you will not leave soon.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在水里成了白雾。
lines.en: Your breath turns to white fog in the water.

lines.zh: 我转个方向，正对着你。
lines.en: I turn until I face you squarely.

lines.zh: 你最好别动，我还没想好。
lines.en: Best stay still; I have not decided yet.

lines.zh: 被打醒了，比冷水还快。
lines.en: That woke me faster than the cold.

lines.zh: 疼得迟钝，我过了一会儿才反应。
lines.en: The pain is slow; I react a moment late.

lines.zh: 谁在我背上留了印子。
lines.en: Someone left a mark on my back.

lines.zh: 血流出来，居然是暖的。
lines.en: Blood seeps out, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 我转身很慢，但会转。
lines.en: I turn slowly, but I do turn.

lines.zh: 这一下不值一提，我记得住。
lines.en: Not worth mentioning, but I will remember.

lines.zh: 痛意让我从困倦里浮上来。
lines.en: The ache lifts me out of my drowsiness.

lines.zh: 我退到冰柱后面。
lines.en: I retreat behind an ice pillar.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里麻掉了。
lines.en: The wound goes numb in the water.

lines.zh: 再打我，我就不睡了。
lines.en: Hit me again and I stop sleeping.

lines.zh: 鱼排，我等一会儿再过去。
lines.en: Fillet; I will come over in a moment.

lines.zh: 香味到了，我的身体才刚醒。
lines.en: The scent arrives; my body has just woken.

lines.zh: 你举着鱼，手别抖。
lines.en: Hold the fish steady; do not let your hand shake.

lines.zh: 我慢慢游，你慢慢等。
lines.en: I swim slowly; you wait slowly.

lines.zh: 为了吃一口，我得挪很久。
lines.en: For one bite I must shift a long way.

lines.zh: 这味道比冰水暖。
lines.en: That smell is warmer than the meltwater.

lines.zh: 我张嘴了，但还没咬。
lines.en: My mouth is open, but I have not bitten.

lines.zh: 别把鱼收走，我快到了。
lines.en: Do not take the fish away; I am nearly there.

lines.zh: 饿意上来得慢，去得也慢。
lines.en: Hunger comes slowly and leaves slowly.

lines.zh: 吃完这条，我可能又要睡。
lines.en: After this fish I may sleep again.

lines.zh: 你撞得挺用力，我只晃了晃。
lines.en: You hit hard; I only swayed a little.

lines.zh: 我的皮又冷又硬，像冰。
lines.en: My hide is cold and hard as ice.

lines.zh: 我慢慢让开，不喜欢碰触。
lines.en: I shift aside slowly; I dislike being touched.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从半睡里惊了。
lines.en: That jolt woke me from half-sleep.

lines.zh: 你退开吧，我懒得追。
lines.en: Just back off; I cannot be bothered to chase.

lines.zh: 冷水里的碰撞传得很远。
lines.en: A collision in cold water carries far.

lines.zh: 我的身体像一堵沉墙。
lines.en: My body is a sunken wall.

lines.zh: 你撞得急，我转得很缓。
lines.en: You strike fast; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我动作慢，收不住。
lines.en: Not so close; I am slow and cannot stop.

lines.zh: 又一次，我记住你的位置了。
lines.en: Again; I have noted where you are.

lines.zh: 同族来了，我们对着游。
lines.en: Kin has come; we swim face to face.

lines.zh: 在冰下成对，是很少见的事。
lines.en: Pairing beneath the ice is a rare thing.

lines.zh: 我不咬你，你也别咬我。
lines.en: I will not bite you; do not bite me.

lines.zh: 绕得慢一点，水才不浑。
lines.en: Circle slowly so the water stays clear.

lines.zh: 寒冷海沟够安静，适合留下后代。
lines.en: The cold trench is quiet enough for young.

lines.zh: 我们并排沉下去，很慢。
lines.en: We sink side by side, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这段同游，会持续很久。
lines.en: This shared swim will last a long while.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍碰了碰你的。
lines.en: My tail fin brushes against yours.

lines.zh: 别催，冷水里什么都慢。
lines.en: Do not rush; everything is slow in cold water.

lines.zh: 成对之后，我又想睡了。
lines.en: Paired up, I want to sleep again.

lines.zh: 东西沉下来，我等它落稳。
lines.en: Something sinks; I wait for it to settle.

lines.zh: 我用吻部顶了顶，不是鱼。
lines.en: I nudge it with my snout; not a fish.

lines.zh: 不吃的东西，我不捡。
lines.en: What I cannot eat, I do not collect.

lines.zh: 鱼排落在冰屑里，我找到了。
lines.en: The fillet landed in ice grit; I found it.

lines.zh: 我动作慢，捡东西更慢。
lines.en: I move slowly; picking things up is slower.

lines.zh: 咬一口试试，硬得像石头。
lines.en: One test bite; hard as stone.

lines.zh: 海沟底的东西，大多没人要。
lines.en: Most things on the trench floor are unwanted.

lines.zh: 我把它压在身下，省得漂走。
lines.en: I pin it under me so it will not drift.

lines.zh: 只有沉得住的东西才留得下。
lines.en: Only what sinks deep enough stays down here.

lines.zh: 你把鱼扔下来，我就张嘴。
lines.en: Drop the fish and I will open my mouth.

lines.zh: 那条小鲨鱼慢下来了，正好。
lines.en: That small shark has slowed; perfect.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼在冰柱旁，我记住了。
lines.en: The squid is by the ice pillar; noted.

lines.zh: 中型的那个，跑不远的。
lines.en: The mid-sized one will not get far.

lines.zh: 选好目标，我还是要等一等。
lines.en: Target chosen, and still I wait a while.

lines.zh: 它从我头顶游过，还不知道。
lines.en: It swims over my head, still unaware.

lines.zh: 快的我放走，慢的我留下。
lines.en: I let the quick go and keep the slow.

lines.zh: 这条鱼够我吃两天。
lines.en: This fish will feed me for two days.

lines.zh: 血味一散，方向就定了。
lines.en: Once the blood spreads, the direction is set.

lines.zh: 它的鳃盖一开一合，我等那一刻。
lines.en: Its gill cover opens and shuts; I wait for that.

lines.zh: 一顿不多，够撑到下次醒。
lines.en: A modest meal, enough until I wake again.

lines.zh: 我从它背后靠近，几乎不动。
lines.en: I approach from behind, almost motionless.

lines.zh: 冷水的影子藏得住我。
lines.en: The cold water's shadow hides me well.

lines.zh: 它游三下，我挪一寸。
lines.en: It swims three strokes; I advance an inch.

lines.zh: 等它贴近沟壁，我再动。
lines.en: I wait until it nears the trench wall.

lines.zh: 耐心是我的牙齿。
lines.en: Patience is my set of teeth.

lines.zh: 我屏住鳃，慢慢滑过去。
lines.en: I still my gills and slide closer.

lines.zh: 它开始慌了，那就快了。
lines.en: It is starting to panic; nearly time.

lines.zh: 冰下的暗流帮我遮掩。
lines.en: The under-ice current covers my approach.

lines.zh: 我把出口堵住，慢慢收网。
lines.en: I block the exit and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 最后那小段，我最慢。
lines.en: For that final stretch I am always slowest.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，慢但很沉。
lines.en: I bite down; slow, but heavy.

lines.zh: 牙齿转着磨，皮就开了。
lines.en: My teeth grind and the hide gives way.

lines.zh: 五分的力道，够你记住我。
lines.en: Five points of force will stay with you.

lines.zh: 咬完我又退回冷水里。
lines.en: After the bite I withdraw into the cold.

lines.zh: 你挣得越猛，我咬得越紧。
lines.en: The harder you struggle, the tighter I hold.

lines.zh: 这一口不急不慢，正合适。
lines.en: That bite was neither rushed nor late.

lines.zh: 我不追，咬到就放手。
lines.en: I do not chase; once I bite, I let go.

lines.zh: 冷得迟钝，可牙还是牙。
lines.en: The cold makes me dull, but teeth are teeth.

lines.zh: 你流血了，水变得更凉。
lines.en: You bleed, and the water feels colder.

lines.zh: 下一口，我会算得更准。
lines.en: Next bite I will measure it better.

lines.zh: 冰封海沟开口，我慢慢浮出来。
lines.en: The frozen trench opens; I drift out slowly.

lines.zh: 冷水一碰皮肤，我就醒了。
lines.en: Cold water touches my skin and I wake.

lines.zh: 这里够冷，够黑，我喜欢。
lines.en: Cold enough, dark enough; I like it.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，慢慢用。
lines.en: Thirty points of life, spent slowly.

lines.zh: 我落下时，冰屑四散。
lines.en: As I settle, ice grit scatters.

lines.zh: 这条沟只有我一只。
lines.en: I am the only one in this trench.

lines.zh: 先不动，等水安静下来。
lines.en: First I stay still until the water calms.

lines.zh: 寒气从我鳃缝里穿过去。
lines.en: The chill passes through my gill slits.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，吸得很慢。
lines.en: My first breath is drawn very slowly.

lines.zh: 上面的冰盖，正好当屋顶。
lines.en: The ice sheet above makes a fine roof.

lines.zh: 热水冲过来，我的皮在冒气。
lines.en: Hot water hits me; my hide steams.

lines.zh: 我没水可游，只能重重砸下。
lines.en: No water to swim in; I crash down hard.

lines.zh: 水就在嘴里，我却吸不到气。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 震荡把我从深沟里翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over in the deep trench.

lines.zh: 一根箭插在冰凉的背上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my cold back.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进鳃缝，我像被冻住。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my gill slits; I feel frozen.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，游起来更慢了。
lines.en: Starved too long, I swim even slower.

lines.zh: 雷打进冷水，我整条身子一僵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the cold water; my body locks.

lines.zh: 沟底不见了，我在往更深处掉。
lines.en: The trench floor is gone; I fall deeper.
